context: Sho and Hina sing along to a music video.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、この歌、一緒に、歌おう。
lines.en: Sho, come sing this song with me!
lines.style: Bright, inviting opening with genuine excitement. Light bounce in the voice—an eight-year-old who means every word. No performance, just pure enthusiasm bubbling through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah—it's one of my favorite songs.
lines.style: Soft, quiet agreement. Small genuine smile audible. Warm but unshowy. A six-year-old who is genuinely pleased, not performing pleasure.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Encouraging, lifting energy in the middle register. Warm and natural—not commanding, inviting. The brightness of a child who wants to include her friend in something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Singing with you is really fun.
lines.style: Soft, genuine statement. Small wonder in the voice—a six-year-old noticing something true. Quiet contentment. No extra effort, just simple honesty.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I want to sing together like this every day.
lines.style: Tender closing. Bright but sincere underneath—an eight-year-old expressing something that matters. Soft at the edges, genuine warmth threading through the whole line.
